evidence.explanation: Il passaggio non comporta costi di uscita e il contratto fissa il prezzo per un anno; di conseguenza la spesa resta prevedibile.
evidence.closing: Confronti prima le tariffe: col variabile il cambio può convenire; col fisso aspetterei la fine, in base alla scadenza del contratto.
evidence.specification: The two exact V4 scaffold edits match these revised explanation and conclusion premises.

resolvedFindings.verification: The unsupported no-exit-fee → fixed-year commitment inference is removed. The final recommendation explicitly starts with tariff comparison and is conditional. Both 21-token turns meet their bounds; cloze/synthesis, bilingual cues/bases, pattern example/rule, attested terms and speech tokens were read and tested as coupled final values.
Existing 7–12 focus cap retained. Relative superlative and two speech anchors remain in focus; exact reconstruction passes. The per tutti displacement is bound inside one chip.

Existing cap retained, carrier and speech anchors in focus, exact suffix urgente entro tre giorni. preserved. A verb/object swap creates trenta pagine urgente; conjunction placement precludes the simple reversed-clause order.

The old c’era-before-a-monte counterexample cannot be assembled from the new bound chip. Both rhetorical halves remain in focus. Plausible residual locative placements do not preserve the intended cause-to-decision reading; this is a semantic judgment, not an algorithmic uniqueness certificate.

The true it-IT offline gate is staged and independently reviewed. All four original engineering findings are resolved in the declared bounded scope, 106 actual final-source probes pass, strict TS/lint pass. This resolves absence of an approved native gate, not runtime rendering, acceptance or a paid pipeline.

fullCoverage.fields: Every root field and every field of all twenty lessons: IDs/slugs/titles/situations/captions, episode/register/interlocutor/gender metadata, all target turns and de/en bases, build frames/chunks/distractors, cloze and synthesis segments/answers/acceptedAnswers/choices/cues/moveBlankIndex, recall context/alternatives/fallbacks, pattern labels/rules/examples/bases/highlights, terms/lemmas/glosses, speak tokens/profiles, trophies/examples/bases and every review field.

No diff-only or sampled read. The current machine inventory independently confirms the field counts.

perLesson.assessment: Concrete garden/time challenge and budget-constrained conclusion; paired contrast and concession native, neutral speaker; choice and form cue coherent.

Strike becomes un'eccezione with cloze/base coupling; subsidy changes the final calculation; no learner-gender agreement. The colleague's bloccati is a group form, not a gendered learner self-description.

Corrected scene describes an existing remote arrangement; team support and launch-week constraint motivate the compromise. Licensed potremmo invece is the required carrier; incidental alternatives follow the stated contract.

Fifteen rental weeks equals nine hundred at sixty per week; repair gives about eighteen months with one week per month. Machine/manutenzione agreement has explicit non-speaker subjects; userei remains incidental in the frame.
Tu matches the friend scene; entrambe agrees with proposte, not the learner. Summer decision clarified and title no longer reveals the two-season proposal.
Cash/app trade-off, small-ticket challenge and optional dual payment conclusion cohere; fictional fee attributed to PagoQui. Explicit articulated-preposition comparison preserved.
Tu, fixed appointments and learner consistency lead to an adapted recommendation; recall now targets rispetto. No learner agreement forced.
Salary/development comparison and written-training condition cohere. sia scritta refers to formazione; subjunctive is not a blank or speech requirement. Tanto...quanto halves stay inside the focus.
Job stability and retained-home trial respond to the counterexample; illustrative niece has feminine agreement without gendering the learner. Earlier carrier and accent variants preserved.

Full final reread: eleven-token focus, with più utile per tutti bound and economici in focus. Exact reconstruction and utile/portabici speech coverage pass; no coherent second order found. Budget challenge and deferred-project closing remain sound.

Full final reread: twelve-token focus, urgent singular delivery phrase in suffix. Object-swap alternative would attach urgente to trenta pagine and fails agreement; poiché and required speech anchors remain in focus. Invoice arithmetic and written attribution remain coherent.

All procedure and disposal claims are attributed to a fictional notice. Third-person singular indicative separa/espone/ritira can describe the addressee's sequence under Lei; later consulti is a direct formal instruction, not a switch to tu.

Supplier/team delays are distinguished and closing offers a target rather than a guarantee; corrected German base matches the causal wording. slittato agrees with il collaudo. Original isolated in ritardo reorder is removed.
Fictional point/expiry terms are explicit; buying only planned items answers overspending; seasonal limit qualifies the benefit. si accumulano is plural; revised riassumo gloss is accurate.

Full final reread: explicit fixed-price-for-a-year premise supports predictable spending, and the closing first requests tariff comparison and says può convenire. Cloze fissa with its bilingual form cue, both bases, synthesis, exact pattern example and speech tokens are coupled. Aspetterei is incidental and unblanked.

Legal procedure is strictly attributed to this fictional notice; no universal deadline or automatic increased fine is asserted. compila/allega/conserva are acceptable descriptive Lei indicatives in this explanatory context; existing evidence is not invented.

Nominalisation and partial concession are licensed in the late band; costasse is incidental and unblanked. mancata agrees with verifica and sbagliato with presupposto. Presupposto family is presupporre.
Clinic criteria are fictionally attributed; no guaranteed urgent slot. si valutano/in base ai and a seconda del carriers occur in allocated surfaces. Request date supplies the final operational rule.
Usage percentages are fictional report claims, not outside statistics. Incidental conditionals and the interlocutor's uscisse are not taught blanks; raddoppiato agrees with l'uso.

Full final reread: A monte c’era is bound in a single chip. Both carrier halves and monte/chiusura/voto are in eleven-token focus; the previous verb-first permutation is unavailable. Tested plausible residual orders change the meaning to spatial relations or break the decision-chain reading. No coherent equivalent order found.
